postconditions.expression: all(num_digit == str(int(num))[i] for i, num_digit in enumerate(return_value.split('-'))) and len(return_value.split('-')) == sum(1 for d in str(int(num)) if int(d) % 2 == 1 and int(d) != 0) + 1
postconditions.description: The output string is formed by inserting dashes between every pair of odd digits in the input number (excluding zero), preserving the original digit order and sequence. The output is a concatenation of digit groups separated by dashes, where each group is one or more consecutive non-odd digits or a single odd digit (except zero).

postconditions.description: If the input number has no odd digits (excluding zero), the output is the original number as a string. Otherwise, the output differs from the original string by containing dashes between odd digits.
